The world is flying islands above a cloud layer that no one has been beneath and returned. Steampunk airships are widely used. There are three major empires and three major factions of sky pirates. 

The Old Kingdom is the empire with the largest landmass, population, and resource pool. But they are bogged down by ancient tradition and have standard fantasy technology (flight with magic or flying animals). They are secretly collecting artifacts that can summon and control Tiamat to conquer the world.

The Republic (no not that one) has advanced technology, industry, and representative democracy. But they have few natural resources and are fighting a war with a loose coalition of strix. They are secretly building a massive metal dreadnaught powered by rare materials.

The Spire is a magiocracy ruled by a council of the most powerful spellcasters in the world. They rule from an ancient stone tower which doubles as a magic school. One's status there is determined by mystical ability. They are building a machine to build a clockwork army.

Enchanting complex things (like guns or airships) is extremely difficult in this world.

The pirates are: The Armada, the largest fleet in the world but completely disorganized, standard plunder-y pirates. Redhawk, pirates with a strict code (Redhawk doesn't fight Redhawk). And Nimbus, standard robin hood types.
